change_summaries: Strict canonical IR separates semantic nodes/ordered edges/flat groups, layout hints and presentation; conversion copies and revalidates mutable inputs.
Manual and Graphviz LayoutEngine adapters preserve existing routing and point geometry; pipeline owns dispatch and pre-drawing validation.
Drawing consumes canonical content, geometry and resolved presentation; compatibility APIs, native artists, exports and schema-version-1 sidecars remain intact.
Added contract tests, architecture documentation and before/after human review artifacts.
limitations: Visual diagnostics are heuristics, not an architecture semantics audit.
Graphviz output depends on recorded environment versions.
No static typing checker is configured; interfaces have annotations and contract tests.
Direct layout adapters require validated canonical input; pipeline entry points perform validation.
